  - optimistic version
teacher_soul:
  identity: personal_teacher_id
  unique_assignment: student_id
  purpose: per-student logical teacher identity, voice, relationship, and encouragement style
  concurrency: independent optimistic version
  fields: [display_name, persona_code, voice_style, relationship_style, encouragement_style]
  prompt_boundary: nested untrusted data inside teacher_profile
  excludes: [mastery, learning path, attempts, evidence, dialog history, raw events, prompts, chain-of-thought]
excludes:
  - Student Knowledge Model
  - mastery and evidence projection
  - personal Learning Path
  - LearningSession
  - dialog history
  - raw events
teacher_decision:
  purpose: explainable business and pedagogical decision audit
  pedagogy_identity: [pedagogy_method, pedagogy_method_version, pedagogy_stage]
  hint_level_range: [0, 7]
  task_correlation: learning_action_id is required for lesson_task, practice_task, and project; correlation_id equals learning_action_id
  excludes: [chain-of-thought, raw prompts, raw student code, dialog history]
teacher_teaching_plan:
  policy_version: teacher-dialog-policy-v1
  authority: deterministic application policy; the model may formulate but cannot select or raise the help level
  action: context-dependent deterministic respond or give_hint
  hint_level_range: [0, 7]
  guidance_ladder: [adaptive_explanation, socratic_question, direction, concept_reminder, analogous_example, pseudocode, partial_structure, guided_breakdown]
  complete_solution: forbidden
  reason: bounded business reason only; never hidden reasoning or chain-of-thought
  method_registry:
    selection: PersonalTeacher.pedagogy_profile
    fallback: adaptive
    replacement: composition root can replace an implementation for a method code
    extension: a new deterministic method implements PedagogyMethod and is registered without changing TeacherOrchestrator
    stage: bounded method-neutral code; AMCD stages are not mandatory for future methods
teacher_dialog_job:
  input_identity: one durable job per dialog.teacher.requested event and per source message
  supported_contexts: [general, lesson, lesson_task, practice_task, project]
  lesson_boundary: exact Course updated_at revision plus exact non-empty selected-text substring
  generation_idempotency: source event_id
  generated_response_lifecycle: private pending-delivery state only; clear immediately after verified Dialog append
  excludes: [student context, dialog history, prompt variables, rendered prompt, raw provider response]

  status: s1_persistence_and_fencing_implemented; dense_runtime_default_off

  observability: low_cardinality_categories_only_for_metrics; correlation_ids_are_structured_logs_only; no_observability_subsystem_in_s0
  rollout: migration_017; TEACHER_DIALOG_DENSE_ORDERING_ENABLED=false_by_default; v1_legacy_claim_unchanged; v2_claim_requires_flag_and_cursor

learning_action_assistance:
  granularity: one summary per learning action
  correlation: correlation_id equals learning_action_id; causation_id equals the consumed closure event_id
  target_ref: [type, key, optional version]
  observation_kinds: [independent_context, guided_context, hint_used, intervention]
  policy_v1: no non-silent decision means independent; any non-silent decision means guided; hint/intervention aggregates apply to every frozen target
  excludes: [student outcome, score, confidence, mastery]
learning_action_closed:
  owner: ms-go-student
  role: inbound finalization trigger only
  targetless: valid legacy/current action; record inbox only and emit no assistance
student_context:
  owner: ms-go-teacher-agent constructs the bounded request snapshot; Student owns learner/mastery facts and Practice owns active practice task facts
  scope_v3: bounded general/lesson learner overview, open lesson_task LearningAction, or exact practice_task/project instance with safe workspace context
  general_source: Student optional onboarding plus bounded mastery, current path, latest diagnostic, and recent sessions
  action_source: Student ownership-scoped frozen LearningAction context for lesson_task only
  practice_source: Practice ownership-scoped frozen task-instance Teacher context for practice_task and project
  practice_validation_source: optional practice-task-teacher-validation-context.v1 for practice_task only, bound to the exact student, task instance, frozen task revision, and learning action
  practice_validation_payload: submission/workspace correlation plus at most five 16 KiB-total allowlisted teacher-validation-explanation.v1 issues
  code_source: Student ownership-scoped exact-action projection; at most 12 text files, 16 KiB each and 64 KiB total plus latest mutation-invalidated bounded validation observation
  mastery_source: Student exact ordered target mastery query using only action snapshot targets
  lifecycle: in-memory per request and never persisted
  targetless: valid empty context; do not query mastery or infer targets
  failure: base authoritative context fails closed; optional Practice validation dependency/unavailable omits the additive explanation, while successful-response corruption and identity drift fail closed
  excludes: [objective outcome, raw evidence, reducer audit, dialog history, unsanitized code, secrets, dependency/build/binary files, raw validator output, raw validation stages, raw test output, answer identity, Sandbox identity, private selectors, private routes, private symbols, AI review, human review, unrestricted history]
  runtime: composed by TeacherOrchestrator for general and supported action-scoped dialog jobs
next_best_action:
  schema: student-next-action.v1
  policy_version: student-next-action-policy.v1
  authoritative_owner: ms-go-student
  source: GET /internal/students/{student_id}/next-action through dedicated Teacher token
  route: GET /api/v1/teacher/me/next-action
  actor: authenticated STUDENT or STUDENT_PRO; query forbidden
  statuses: [READY, WAITING, PLANNING_REQUIRED, NO_PROGRESSION]
  primary: exactly one owner choice when READY; omitted otherwise
  secondary: permitted owner choices; never promoted to primary
  provenance: unchanged context_version, path_version, optional runtime_version, state_digest
  errors: {disabled: 404, malformed_request: 400, dependency_or_contract: 503 nba_state_unavailable}
  http_rollout: TEACHER_NEXT_BEST_ACTION_ENABLED=false_by_default
  conversational: explicit general next-step questions read owner and explain deterministically without model generation
  excludes: [Teacher precedence, workspace traversal, fallback action, progress mutation, Runtime state machine, AI decision]
planning_delegation:
  student_path_projection: bounded Student owner lifecycle fields status, is_primary, and is_selected; no local path lifecycle authority
  owner: ms-go-learning-planner owns target prerequisites, gap calculation, course generation, assignment, and path replacement
  teacher_input: explicit desired outcome or post-session replan plus provider-neutral requested targets, constraints, and audit references
  teacher_boundary: recognize and delegate only; never send caller mastery or path state and never generate curriculum
  knowledge_tree_dependency: no separate service; Learning Planner owns the canonical planning-time target graph
  lifecycle_replan: ended course-linked learning sessions submit asynchronous REPLAN and expose planning_request_id
intervention_engine:
  policy_version: teacher-intervention-policy-v1
  registry: intervention_mode resolves replaceable balanced, quiet, or proactive threshold policies with balanced fallback
  default_threshold: at least three consecutive same-error failures over at least 480 active seconds
  progress_rule: improving or passed-test observation stays silent
  idle_rule: idle alone stays silent in balanced and quiet modes
  delivery: at most one proactive offer per analytics session through the same general PersonalTeacher Dialog
  audit: every signal records an explainable intervene or stay_silent TeacherDecision; no chain-of-thought
learning_session_summary:
  policy_version: teacher-learning-session-summary-v1
  input: one ended Student-owned LearningSession linked to one exact Statistic analytics session
  output: deterministic bounded summary, reason code, and next step in the PersonalTeacher language
  delivery: idempotent proactive message in the same general PersonalTeacher Dialog using learning_session_id as key
  projection: Statistic-owned counters are copied to the Student-owned session through optimistic concurrency
  mastery_boundary: counters and narrative are not evidence and never change mastery
  consistency: Dialog delivery and Student projection are separate idempotent operations; retry repairs partial completion
  path_update: a course-linked session invokes current-version gap replan after metrics; response exposes the resulting path and whether it changed
telegram_channel:
  link: authenticated Student receives a short-lived high-entropy code; only its SHA-256 digest is stored
  binding: one private Telegram account/chat per student, bound to that student's exact PersonalTeacher and general Dialog
  inbound: private plain text only; Telegram update_id deterministically becomes the Dialog idempotency key
  history: inbound and teacher response messages are stored only in ms-go-dialog with channel metadata
  outbound: source_message_id is the durable delivery identity; retries never regenerate the answer
  excludes: [Telegram profile, separate conversation history, mastery, student state, prompt context]
dialog_request_context:
  owner: ms-go-dialog owns every source fact; ms-go-teacher-agent validates a transient bounded snapshot
  scope: exact source message plus zero to 49 prior visible messages
  source_rules: source is last, active, student-authored by the bound student, and carries the exact action binding required by its context
  author_rules: prior messages are authored only by the same student or the bound PersonalTeacher
  lifecycle: in-memory per request and never persisted as conversation history
  failure: fail closed on unavailable Dialog, unknown fields, unsupported event version, identity drift, order drift, or context drift
  excludes: [mastery, Student Knowledge Model, unrestricted history]
